audit_findings: All preregistered chronological training fold return and PF gates pass.
Base, severe and supersevere aggregate returns are positive; supersevere PF remains above 1.
No ruin occurred and both open/close gross stayed below the frozen 0.35 cap.
All three regime buckets contributed positively; tails are not dominated by the top/bottom 10 days.
Largest asset contribution share is below 35%, reducing single-asset concentration concern.
2025 is materially weaker than 2023/2024, so validation must be treated as a genuine decay test, not a formality.
No validation or final-holdout result was used in this audit.
